purpose: Labeled worker failure texts for adapters.base.classify_failure (IMP-0015). Texts follow documented provider error shapes (Anthropic API errors incl. 529 overloaded_error, OpenAI/Codex rate-limit and 5xx messages, common network errors); they are representative formats, not verbatim captures of a specific incident.
label_rule: quota = the account or rate budget is exhausted and waiting for a reset is the remedy; unavailable = a transient server, capacity or network failure surfaced after the CLI's own retries (the HTTP adapter already maps 5xx/529 to unavailable); invalid_model = the requested model does not exist or is not enabled; process_error = anything else (worker/tool failure, bad output, non-provider errors).
